title: Samurai Troopers Memorials, Volume 1
originalTitle: サムライトルーパー・メモリアルズ上巻
summary: Covers episodes 1-19 with a Murase poster, film digest pages with episode illustrations, setting material, character profiles, early planning documents, and voice-actor interviews. The source reviewer finds it expensive for half a TV series and criticizes much of the episode art, while noting the interesting early animal-companion concepts: Byakuen, Kotetsumaru, Fubuki, Hiten, and Suimajin.
